# Know Your Meme & Scientific American

> > Documentation of viral internet culture, memes, and trends primarily from TikTok, Twitter/X, and Reddit, with comprehensive explanations of catchphrases, exploitable formats, and social media phenomena.

This collection primarily focuses on Know Your Meme's extensive database of internet culture documentation, featuring viral TikTok trends, image macros, and social media memes. The site catalogs the origins, spread, and cultural context of digital phenomena across platforms like TikTok, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Internet slang and catchphrases
- Viral meme explanations
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Dance memes and challenges
- Pop culture references
- Breaking Bad memes
- Hood culture and nostalgia
- Looksmaxxing community
- Cat memes
- Mental health humor
- Millennial culture

## TikTok Trends & Dance Memes

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok
- [Millennial Burger Place | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/millennial-burger-place): TikTok trend mocking millennial burger restaurant cliches and stereotypes

## Exploitable Memes & Image Macros

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring cat/kitten art that went viral on TikTok
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman
